## About
Martin Mechanical Holding Electrical Services is an electrician based at S Michigan Ave in Chicago. We take on home electrical jobs big and small, from outlet work before a sale to adding a sub breaker box for an EV charger.
Our customers have rated us 5 from 48 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote that we explained all elements of the work, and another said we prioritized safety and kept the work clean and organized. That is how we like to do every job.

## Services
- EV charging outlets and sub breaker boxes: We install a second outlet and a sub breaker box so you can charge your electric vehicle at home.
- Outlet work: Getting your home ready to sell or just need your outlets taken care of? We handle outlets around the house and get the job done quickly.
- Meter box and line work: We handle replacing meter boxes and lines to get your power back on, including after storm damage.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open every day of the week, Monday through Sunday, from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

Q: Can you help after a storm knocks out my power?
A: One reviewer lost power after a tornado and storm. We replaced their meter box and line and finished the job even after it started raining.

Q: Do you work on utility poles for ComEd lines?
A: Yes. One reviewer needed an additional utility pole placed in their yard to support their ComEd lines, and said the work was done professionally without any issues.
